info.name: 📌 OpenRouter API
info.description:
### About

"The unified interface for every model."

OpenRouter routes one API to hundreds of models from many providers, with automatic routing and fallbacks. Model providers include OpenAI, Amazon, Anthropic, Google, Mistral, xAI and more. On the workspace overview it is listed under **Routers & aggregators**.

### Prerequisites

- Postman Account
    
- OpenRouter Account: [https://openrouter.ai/](https://openrouter.ai/)
    

### Usage

1. Create a fork
    
2. Update collection variables
    
3. Send requests

Start with the 🚀 Get Started folder.

Add your key to your **Postman Vault** as `openrouter_api_key` (Vault icon in the footer, then **Add secret**, using that exact name). Requests read it as `{{vault:openrouter_api_key}}`, so your key never leaves your device.

### Documentation

- API: [https://openrouter.ai/docs/quickstart#using-the-openrouter-api-directly](https://openrouter.ai/docs/quickstart#using-the-openrouter-api-directly)
    
- Models: [https://openrouter.ai/models](https://openrouter.ai/models)
